script.text: The second semifinal match was Joey versus Bandit Keith. In order to compete in the duel, each contestant had to present his tournament entry card – which Joey shockingly did not have!
Unknown to Joey, Bandit Keith stole Joey's entry card the night before. Per the rules of the tournament, Joey was granted five minutes to find his card or be disqualified.
Joey searched everywhere but was unable to find it. On his way back to the arena, he broke down in the hallway.
Sorry, sis. I came close. Real close.
Get up off the floor, Joey! And quit all your crying already. You look like a big baby!
Who’s cryin’? I got somethin’ in my eye! Stupid thing won’t come out...
Mai handed him her handkerchief.
Here. Just don’t go blowin’ your nose in it.
You know, every time I think I've got you figured, you surprise me.
Huh?
Téa told me about your little sister. How you’re dueling to win the tournament’s prize money for her so she can have that operation.
Sounded like a bad soap opera to be honest, but then, who doesn’t love a bad soap opera? Anyway, see ya around, hun.
As Mai walked away, Joey noticed she had hidden her tournament entry card in the handkerchief.
Wait! Mai!
Take it. I don't need it anymore. One thing though.
Huh?
Take Bandit Keith down.
Joey ran back to the arena.
So the punk’s come to give us the bad news, huh? Lemme guess... you couldn’t find that card anywhere.
Whadaya talking about? I got it right here.
All right, Keith. Time 'ta duel!
Fine. You know, a part a’ me wanted you to show up. A nice little warm-up match might do me some good.
I'll warm you up and wear you out!
Tell me how it feels to be an amateur goin’ up against the Intercontinental Duelin’ Champion!
Ooooh! The Intercontinental Championship! I could win a better prize than that in a box a’ cereal!
Punk, I’ll teach you to respect my title!
